messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 PAGE — embed-queue throughput spike detected in us-west. 90th p99 latency rising, error rate up. Paging oncall.

devon: I’m oncall, looking now. any obvious deploys? :eyes:

sam: noticing a short-lived traffic surge from a partner job, causing KV cache pressure and backpressure on embedder pool.

priya: seeing lots of KV eviction logs: `kvcache: evict 72% -> 95%` — embedder queue backlog ~4200 requests.

lucas: started a temporary scale-up of embedder-autoscale group by +4 GPUs (manual) to drain queue. command:
```
infractl scale embedder-autoscale --region us-west --delta 4
```

devon: good. also flipping prefix cache TTL to 30s for partner namespace to reduce churn. patch pushed via infra run (rolling): `cachectl set-ttl partner-namespace 30s`.

maria: routing fallback enabled for low-priority customers to model-compact variant (no customer-visible config change). added: `route policy fallback: model-compact if latency>500ms`.

sam: queue draining, backlog down to ~1200. latency p95 improving from 2.8s -> 1.1s. errors reduced. marking mitigation as successful for now. :white_check_mark:

devon: quick customer-impact note: two customers reported degraded embeds (internal incident-triage ticket INF-1234). estimated affected requests ~0.6% of global volume during peak. no SLA breach yet but close to threshold for P1.

priya: recording immediate action items in the ticket and here for handoff:
- A1 (devon): autoscale policy tweak to add burst headroom for partner jobs — size: S (1-2d), priority: P0 for infra stability.
- A2 (sam): add protection in KV cache eviction logic to avoid global TTL storms (prevent cascade) — size: M (3-5d), priority: P1.
- A3 (lucas): create canary for model-compact fallback to validate quality impact before auto-route — size: S (2d), priority: P1.
- A4 (maria): customer comms draft for two customers and account execs — size: S (<1d), priority: P0.

devon: adding one more — A5: add observability alert for sustained embedder queue >2k for 3m (owner: priya) size: S, priority: P0.

priya: agreed. tagging these into INF-1234 and assigning owners. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1234

oncall-summary-bot: post-incident summary created and scheduled for review. Proposed postmortem slot: Tue 2026-03-24 10:00am PT. Attendees: eng-runtime, eng-ml, oncall, infra. (use /calendar accept to confirm)

devon: Tue works for me. prefer to keep it timeboxed to 45m — focus: root cause, remediation, rolling prevention, and Q2 roadmap tie-ins.

sam: I can present KV eviction findings. will bring sample logs and a small repro in a containerized job.

lucas: will prep the canary plan and estimate rollout timeline; propose adding to Q2 sprint 2 for infra QoS improvements.

maria: I’ll send the comms and sync with account execs. will also add a short status update to the customer incident page.

devon: sizing notes for planning (for postmortem to accept into sprint):
- Autoscale policy tweak (A1): small infra config change + test = S
- KV eviction protection (A2): needs design + testing = M
- Canary fallback (A3): S
- Alerts + dashboard tweaks (A5): S
- Customer comms (A4): S

priya: priority ordering for backlog intake (P0 first): A1, A5, A4 then A2/A3. A2 touches core cache logic so needs more soak.

sam: agree. recommend A1 and A5 be in next sprint, A2 be in sprint+1 with canary A3 to validate.

maria: adding to the quarterly plan doc under "Reliability — Embedding pipeline" and marking A1/A5 as Q2 sprint-1 candidates.

devon: ok moving forward: owners update INF-1234 with ETA, update postmortem draft before the meeting, and add playbook note about TTL ramp for partner jobs.

lucas: will run the canary in staging and post results to the thread by EOD.

priya: creating the postmortem doc now and linking it in the ticket. will ping when ready.

devon: thanks all. closing live mitigation log. will follow up in postmortem. :pray:

incident-bot: Incident marked as mitigated by devon at 2801234725. Postmortem meeting scheduled."
